answer: Grab's Mobility GMV was $7.9 billion ($7,901 million) in FY2025, up 19% from $6.6 billion ($6,640 million) in FY2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.96]. This growth was driven by an increase in transaction volume and growth in mobility monthly transacting users (MTUs) [Grab, FY2025, p.96].
